name: Caldera House
positioning: Intimate boutique hotel of multi-bedroom suites in Teton Village, a few feet from the Jackson Hole Mountain Resort tram
best_for: Groups and families who want a multi-bedroom suite with its own kitchen at the base of the mountain
Travelers who want a concierge to arrange skiing, wildlife and national park adventures

facts.text: Caldera House is in the heart of Teton Village, a few feet from the Jackson Hole Mountain Resort tram.
Grand Teton National Park is a short drive from the hotel.
Caldera House is an intimate boutique hotel beneath the mountains of Jackson Hole.
The hotel has modern furnishings from designers such as John Pawson and Patricia Urquiola.
Each suite has its own chef's kitchen and a spacious dining room.
The Socorro Suite is the most private two-bedroom suite and has its own library.
The Kari Kari Suite has views of Sleeping Indian mountain in the distance.
The Taupo Suite is designed as a modernist sky retreat with a darker color palette and rich textiles.
Massages and therapies are available in the treatment room or in-suite on request.
The Mudroom sports shop on the ground level was founded by Jackson Hole local Gov Carrigan.
Corsa, the hotel's restaurant, nods to authentic trattorias in the Italian Alps.
The hotel offers valet parking and a ski concierge.

highlights.text: The Taupo four-bedroom suite has a heated terrace, a firepit and a soaking tub in the bathroom.
Guests have 24-hour access to a fitness studio with Peloton bikes, a heated outdoor infinity plunge and a cedar dry sauna.
The Yellowstone Suite, the largest two-bedroom suite, has slopeside views and its own in-house laundry.
The hotel offers a private stargazing tour in Grand Teton National Park, reserved for your group.
A dedicated concierge customizes adventures from dog sledding and snow trekking to whitewater rafting and fly fishing.

considerations.text: The hotel recommends contacting it early so it can secure guides and activities before your stay.
Spa treatments require reservations in advance.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
